main-capability.description: Least-privilege shell surface: Tauri's event IPC, window creation and visibility, the title-bar drag permission the overlay style needs, plus the dialog and shell plugins. The native title bar is hidden (Overlay + hiddenTitle), so the page's own toolbar is the drag region — without core:window:allow-start-dragging the window cannot be moved at all. Folder picking is answered host-side through the dialog plugin; opening a URL in the user's browser goes through the daemon, not a plugin command.
